name: id.biz.infaqa/zakat-audit
title: INFAQA Zakat Mal & Sharia Audit MCP
description: Deterministic Indonesian zakat mal calculator, SK BAZNAS 2026 nisab, Kemenag Quran & LexJustisia.

tools.name: calculate_zakat_mal
tools.description: Deterministically calculate Indonesian zakat mal (profesi, tabungan, emas, umkm, saham) with step-by-step audit breakdown, fiqh method comparator, Kemenag RI Quran verses, and LexJustisia regulation citations. Never guesses or hallucinates.

inputs.description: Category inputs in IDR/grams/months. Profesi: {period:"monthly"|"annual", income_idr, bonus_idr, basic_needs_and_debt_idr}. Uang: {cash_idr, savings_idr, deposits_idr, due_debt_idr, haul_months_hijri}. Emas: {gold_grams, excluded_jewelry_grams, due_debt_idr, haul_months_hijri}. Dagang: {kas_usaha_idr, persediaan_idr, piutang_lancar_idr, piutang_macet_idr, aset_tetap_idr, utang_usaha_idr, haul_months_hijri}. Saham: {stock_mode:"trading"|"investment", market_value_idr, dividend_idr, due_debt_idr, haul_months_hijri}.

gold_price_idr_per_gram.description: Optional 24K gold price per gram in IDR (default 1078609, equivalent to SK Ketua BAZNAS No. 15/2026).

tools.name: get_nisab_2026
tools.description: Get official 2026 Indonesian zakat nisab thresholds based on SK Ketua BAZNAS No. 15/2026 (Rp 91.681.728/year, Rp 7.640.144/month, 85g gold).

tools.name: search_zakat_regulations
tools.description: Search verified Indonesian zakat laws, 6 PMAs (PMA 52/2014, 69/2015, 31/2019, 16/2025, 19/2024, 5/2016), UU 23/2011, PP 14/2014, PP 60/2010, PP 18/2009, Fatwa MUI, and direct LexJustisia deep-links.

tools.name: get_zakat_quran_verses
tools.description: Retrieve verified ZIS Quran verses from official LPMQ Kementerian Agama RI with Arabic text, Latin transliteration, and Indonesian translation.

tools.name: list_campus_case_studies
tools.description: List 5 curated Islamic Economics zakat mal case studies (INFQ-CASE-001 to INFQ-CASE-005) for university practicums.

tools.name: search_sharia_research
tools.description: Search 10 peer-reviewed Islamic social finance research papers (2016-2026) with active DOIs and APA citations.
